name: Send correlation-tagged test email to peer
description: test-user-01 sends a second test email to test-user-02 with a deterministic correlation token in the subject. The token matches a value stored in the scenario evidence record. This scenario is used to validate correlation strategy across run boundaries.
correlation_strategy: Subject line carries the scenario-correlation token. The token format is the responsibility of the future runner; this scenario declares only that the field exists.
notes: Mail.Send is required. This scenario depends on SCN-MAIL-001's permission grant and exists primarily to exercise the correlation mechanism.
